decisions.reason: As a newly launched software product with its own page, it appears strategically relevant and is unlikely to be withdrawn after only one year.
Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, it has a somewhat higher withdrawal risk, but it still fits the firm's industrial digital offering.
A prominently presented safety-related hardware product is typically kept, especially when it complements the firm's engineering portfolio.
This water-treatment equipment is close to the firm's machinery business, so despite more limited website emphasis it is more likely to be retained than discontinued.
Control technology for water engineering machinery is highly consistent with the firm's core business and is therefore unlikely to be taken off the market so quickly.
